result.summary: The page is largely coherent, but several rendering problems stand out: a clipped restaurant name in the horizontal carousel, an implausible "-100%" discount badge, inconsistent favorite-icon styling between cards, and content colliding with the fixed bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: The promo badge on the second 'Popular right now' card reads '-100%', implying a 100% discount (free order). This is almost certainly a data/formatting bug rather than a real offer.
issues.suggestion: Validate discount values before rendering and cap/format them correctly (e.g. '-50%' or 'Free item'); guard against 0/100 edge cases from the API.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' has its title truncated mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol') and the image/price are clipped by the viewport edge with no ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow ellipsis with a single-line clamp to card titles, and ensure carousel items snap so partially visible items still render a clean peek.

issues.description: The second pizza card in 'Popular right now' is cut off by the fixed bottom navigation bar — its title, rating and delivery info are hidden behind/below the nav.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scroll container equal to the nav bar height (plus safe-area inset) so the last card can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the first card uses a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the second uses a dark/transparent circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button to one background/icon treatment across all cards, using a scrim if contrast over imagery varies.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped at the right edge with a partially visible chip and no visual scroll affordance (fade or arrow), making it unclear more filters exist.
issues.suggestion: Add a gradient fade or consistent peek offset at the row edge to signal horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: The notification bell's red dot indicator conveys unread state by color/shape only and has no visible label; icon-only nav and heart buttons also lack visible text alternatives.
issues.suggestion: Provide accessible labels (e.g. 'Notifications, 1 unread', 'Add to favorites') for all icon-only controls.

issues.description: The green promo banner's decorative circles are clipped awkwardly at the right/bottom corners, and the 'Order now' button sits close to the banner's bottom edge.
issues.suggestion: Clip decorative shapes to the banner's rounded radius and increase bottom padding for balanced spacing.
